placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for instrument calibration procedures, reference plate verification, and operational observing band standards.
placements.title: Observatory instrument calibration and baseline standards
placements.frame: How are observatory instruments calibrated, verified, and standardized for observation?

placements.title: Verification against established reference baselines ensures full-band instrument stability
placements.frame: How does verification against historical reference baselines ensure observational stability across the full observing band?
placements.why: Captures the principle that calibration against reference plates (such as the June plates for the 88.4 MHz spectrograph) validates instrument reliability across the entire observing band.
